audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Heimerdinger the first item and 2+ item stages and called Levels 4-5 and 6 'Skill', in a 48.01% lane the prose openly describes as Vladimir's after two items.
audit.why: The content whys, the late text and the packet chart all agree: Heimerdinger owns 2 through 5, Vladimir owns 6 onward once Rylai's lands.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Skill / Heim / Heim / Heim / Vlad / Vlad / Vlad with ratings to match.

audit.why: spikes name the even Level 1, the Lvl 3-5 nest peak, the Level 6 UPGRADE!!! burst window, and the 2-item Rylai's/Zhonya's flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Dodges your combo. Bait it.' never said what Sanguine Pool actually does or how long it lasts.
audit.why: Riot's text: untargetable for 2 seconds on a 28/25/22/19/16s cooldown. That is the whole reason your CH-3X stun and turret beams whiff, and the number is the trade window.
audit.corrected: Interactions and cooldown block now state 2s untargetable and the 16-28s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was listed in Itemization but the Do titled 'Build MR + anti-heal' carried unrelated trading text.
audit.why: Both Transfusion and Hemoplague heal him; Grievous Wounds timing is what decides an extended trade.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names Oblivion Orb and both healing sources.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Your second H-28G and its slowing beams out-chip Tides of Blood, and he has no Sanguine Pool charge to escape yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vladimir must walk into your range.
edits.after: Three charges plus the CH-3X center-stun mean a pre-Rylai Vlad cannot step in for a Transfusion last-hit for free.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Sanguine Pool's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your cleanest kill window: burst him while Sanguine Pool sits on its 16-28s cooldown, before any AP item bails him out.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Rylai's lets Vlad kite the nest and his first AP item out-sustains your beam chip — the zone starts slipping here.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Sanguine Pool's cooldown.
edits.after: With two items he pools through your stun and empowered Transfusion drains him full inside the nest.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vladimir carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-AP Vlad pools through the stun, ignores beams while untargetable, and walks the Q-E combo onto an immobile yordle.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-stun + turret him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable and eats your stun — bait it, then commit in its 16-28s down.

edits.before: Dodges your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 2s untargetable, 16-28s cooldown. Commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Oblivion Orb before your first item — Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — 16-28s, 2s untargetable that eats your stun. Bait it first. - Your CH-3X: 11s, save it for his step-up, never for chip. - Your ultimate: 100/85/70s — kill windows only.

notes: Content whys and spikes were already accurate; only the side/rating layer disagreed with them. Whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability cancels an in-flight CH-3X stun that has already applied is not in Riot's text — I stated only that it dodges the burst, not that it cleanses.
